page.content:
The Kwan Dao (關刀) is a type of Chinese pole weapon. In Chinese, it is properly called a "crescent moon blade" (偃月刀).

page.overview:
What is Kwan Dao?

The Kwan Dao (關刀) is a type of Chinese pole weapon. In Chinese, it is properly called a "crescent moon blade" (偃月刀).

Sindel uses a Kwan Dao as her weapon style in Mortal Kombat: Deception, Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, and Mortal Kombat 11.

As the Kwan Dao is a common weapon, it has been shown in several episodes of Mortal Kombat: Conquest.
